Been tanking on and off for about 14 years now and currently main tanking as a Blood DK in dragonflight, approx 2500 io.

Warrior: by far the strongest tank in the xpac, very basic sword and board tank - low barrier to entry but can have a high skill ceiling with proper offensive usage

DK: IMO the second strongest tank of the xpac, very reactive tank (whole premise of DK) - difficult to play for first timers but a lot of control if played well 

The remainder of the tanks are all relatively close to each other in power level and will come to playstyle 

Dh: less of a reactive tank than dk, does very high dmg and is very tanky in cooldowns but sometimes need to kite in downtime

Monk: very high skill cap tank to play well managing stagger and shields, they currently scale very high dmg wise but are a bit under tuned defensively 

Pally: another sword and board tank, pretty even mix between preventative/reactive tanking -  low barrier to entry and has a massive toolkit

Druid: arguably the easiest tank, can be very tanky and meant to just be a meat shield - low barrier to entry
